en.hubeali: (Please note that the full Hadeeth is to be found in Al Kafi – V 4 – The Book of Hajj Ch 28 H 37, for the answer to the second man) Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The Ablution (Wudhu) is part of the Emaan (faith)’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
